terminals.name: website
terminals.description: Astro dev server for apps/website on http://localhost:4321. Loads waverly-website/dev through Doppler when DOPPLER_TOKEN_WEBSITE is set.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=1 bash scripts/cloud-agent-dev.sh website -- ./node_modules/.bin/astro dev --host --port 4321

terminals.name: docs
terminals.description: Astro dev server for apps/docs on http://localhost:4322. Loads waverly-docs/dev through Doppler when DOPPLER_TOKEN_DOCS is set.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; ASTRO_DEV_BACKGROUND=1 bash scripts/cloud-agent-dev.sh docs -- ./node_modules/.bin/astro dev --host --port 4322

terminals.name: affiliate
terminals.description: Affiliate app with isolated local WorkOS and Convex backends on http://localhost:5173. Independent of Doppler.
